transcript.statement: Safety and reliability are paramount for an ATM system. My requirements ensure that accounts cannot enter a negative balance (SAF-01) and that transactions are handled securely through PIN verification (SAF-05). Automatic fund withdrawals from savings (SAF-02) and notifying users of insufficient funds (SAF-03) prevent financial mishaps. Logging transactions (SAF-04) ensures accountability, while safe degradation (SAF-06) allows for limited functionality during maintenance, and clear account summaries (SAF-07) enhance user understanding. However, I see conflicts with EfficiencyAgent's EFF-01 and EFF-02, as the push for rapid transactions might compromise safety protocols.

requirements.text: The ATM system shall ensure that all transactions are encrypted during transmission and maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
The system shall implement user authentication using a secure PIN code mechanism.
The system shall log all transactions along with their timestamps, date, time, type, amount, and updated balance for audit purposes.
The system shall prevent transactions that would result in negative account balances.
The system shall notify users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals.
The ATM system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account if the checking account balance is insufficient.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 4 seconds and maintain a maximum throughput of 90 transactions per minute.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
